title: Construir un Estado
goal: Read what building a state from nothing actually required, and how the federal experiment in Central America collapsed into five separate countries within eighteen years.

items: List the basic questions new states had to answer almost immediately.
Describe what the United Provinces of Central America were.
Explain what happened to that federation, and when.
Explain why the process advanced by trial and error.
Use se-passive/impersonal constructions to describe simultaneous state-building tasks.
